title: Parser assessment manifest
description: Schema for a batch/local parser assessment manifest: one parser run over a local-only sample. Envelope with a non-empty array of page-level assessment records. Tracked schema and synthetic fixtures must never carry real book data, extracted text, OCR text, citations, or file-system paths. The local-only ignored manifest may carry printed page labels and private reviewer notes, but must never carry source text, OCR text, citations, or file-system paths.
